body_word_count.method: Claim prose and captions plus table entries; math expressions count once; excludes title, headings, bibliography, audit, and submission notes.

visual_review.checked: All final submission pages inspected for clipping, overlaps, legibility, table/figure placement, reference rendering and numbering; first four pages match standalone draft.

pdf_links.note: pypdf emitted annotation-size warnings during merge; all final source-page links were retained and all named link targets resolve.
